owner_decision.decision: replace the obsolete eight-one-hour-window rule with a representative review-capacity preflight and continue the offline main design

dispatch_history_contract.writer_mode: process-scoped OS lock plus durable canonical initialization and append intents; recover only an exact intended history-line prefix, fsync the completed line, retain an exclusive prefix receipt, then clear the intent
dispatch_history_contract.crash_recovery: an interrupted initialization is retry-completed only from its exact durable intent; an interrupted append is completed from the exact prior bytes or exact intended-line prefix and is then treated as committed, never redispatched; any other byte state is terminal and fail-closed
dispatch_history_contract.retry_unlock: only a hash-chained and receipt-bound attempt_interrupted event for cohort 1 whose absolute evidence path, byte count, and raw SHA-256 verify under the frozen evidence root unlocks cohort 2
dispatch_history_contract.terminal_completed_failure: attempt_completed_fail is terminal and cannot be followed by another dispatch or omitted from result validation
dispatch_history_contract.no_replay: a cohort may be dispatched at most once; cohort 2 is the only retry cohort and no third cohort exists

measurement_contract.cohort_scope: pre-freeze two disjoint 180-packet cohorts, each split into three nonoverlapping 60-packet waves; dispatch cohort 1 first and cohort 2 only after one verified environmental interruption of cohort 1
measurement_contract.timing: for each wave use a monotonic clock from immediately before reviewer child-process spawn through validated and fsynced result output
pass: each of the three waves contains exactly its 60 expected unique packet and result identities
every result is nonempty and parses under the frozen reviewer-output parser, including valid LABEL and CLAUSE pairing
zero timeout, process error, tool use, prompt-hash mismatch, unexpected row, duplicate row, or missing row
each 60-packet wave completes within 3600 seconds and all three complete within 10800 seconds
measurement_contract.failure: any completed attempt that misses a pass condition is FAIL; do not select a different cohort to erase the result
measurement_contract.evidence: record the resolved reviewer CLI wrapper path, wrapper raw SHA-256 and byte count, reported CLI version, host identity, monotonic durations, UTC boundaries, packet and result hashes, zero-valued failure counters, and one result row per expected prompt
measurement_contract.materialization_only_now: this plan and its script authorize only offline validation and packet materialization

retry_policy.environmental_interruption: void cohort 1 evidence only after appending a verified, structured environmental-interruption event to the bound hash-chained dispatch history
retry_policy.freshness_requirement: the sole retry uses pre-frozen cohort 2, whose 180 prompt hashes are disjoint from historical prompts and cohort 1
retry_policy.completed_failure: any completed failure is terminal; it cannot unlock cohort 2, be erased, or be replaced by a later result
retry_policy.current_reserve: 368 byte-new swaps support exactly two pre-frozen 180-packet cohorts with eight variants unused
retry_policy.blocked_action: after cohort 2 starts, any interruption or completed failure is terminal for this source; a further attempt requires separately reviewed source expansion or semantic-preserving transformation, and whitespace or nonce padding is prohibited

invalidated_by: reviewer CLI resolved wrapper path, wrapper bytes, or reported version change

non_claims: This plan does not launch the reviewer or any provider client.
This plan does not authorize main-run provider calls, spend, or formal measurement.

The source semantics were reviewed in fresh prior sessions. Candidate-order swapping makes request bytes new and prevents exact-prompt replay, but this capacity check is not new semantic-validity evidence.
Cohort 2 is a one-time environmental-interruption retry, not a way to erase a completed failure.
The eight unused eligible swaps do not form another cohort and cannot authorize a third attempt.

The append API, hash chain, byte-verified interruption evidence, and retained prefix receipts fail closed for missing or inconsistent artifacts, but they are not tamper-proof against an actor who can deliberately delete or replace the history, evidence, and receipts together on the trusted local filesystem.
The interruption verifier field is an operator attestation and does not independently prove that the recorded cause was environmental.
The frozen codex.cmd path, wrapper bytes, and reported version identify the reviewer CLI entry point; the wrapper hash alone is not an attestation of the entire installed Codex package.
